`from_roman(text)` returns the `int` for a numeral. It accepts only the exact text that `to_roman` produces for some number. Everything else raises `ValueError`: lower case (`iv`), the empty string, other characters, and non-standard forms such as `IIII`, `VX`, `IC` or `MMMM`.
